Create Risk of Bias Plot

Source: R/rob_plot.R
rob_plot.Rd

Creates a publication-ready risk of bias plot using gt tables, for single studies or subgroup analyses. Uses the same risk of bias internals as the robbR package.

Usage

rob_plot(
  data,
  studyvar = Author,
  yearvar = Year,
  subgroupvar = Subgroup,
  effect = yi,
  rob_tool = "rob2",
  sort_studies_by = c("author", "year", "effect"),
  subgroup = FALSE,
  sort_subgroup_by = "alphabetical",
  show_overall = TRUE,
  derive_overall = FALSE,
  add_rob_legend = FALSE,
  study_label = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  title_align = c("left", "center", "centre", "right"),
  subtitle = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with a study, year and domain columns for the chosen rob_tool (see Details). Judgements are standardised (e.g. "low risk" -> "Low"); NA -> "Not applicable". Judgements not recognised by the tool are shown as blank cells, with a warning.

studyvar, yearvar

<data-masking> Study label and year columns.

subgroupvar

<data-masking> Subgroup column, used when subgroup = TRUE.

effect

<data-masking> Effect size column, used when sorting by "effect".

rob_tool

Risk of bias tool: "rob2" (default), "robins_i", "robins_e", "quadas2", "clarity", "rob_nma", "probast", or "probast_ai".

sort_studies_by

How to sort studies: "author" (default), "year", or "effect".

subgroup

Logical. Create a subgroup plot? (default: FALSE).

sort_subgroup_by

Subgroup ordering: "alphabetical" (default), "effect", or a character vector of subgroup names in the desired order.

show_overall

Logical. Show the overall column(s)? (default: TRUE). Overall columns absent from data are derived from the domains (worst judgement).

derive_overall

Logical. Always re-derive overall column(s) from the domains, overwriting supplied values? (default: FALSE).

add_rob_legend

Logical. Add a legend? (default: FALSE).

study_label

Header for the study column. Defaults to "Trial" for randomised trial tools ("rob2", "clarity"), "Review" for "rob_nma", and "Study" otherwise.

font

Font family.

title, subtitle

Plot title and subtitle.

title_align

Title alignment: "left" (default), "center"/"centre", or "right".

Value

A patchwork composition of the risk of bias table (and legend).

Details

Domain columns by tool (optional columns in brackets are shown only if present; NA rows are shown as "Not applicable"):

rob2

D1, (D1b), D2-D5, (DS), Overall.

robins_i

ROBINS-I V2: D1-D6, Overall.

robins_e

D1-D7, Overall.

quadas2

D1-D4, Overall.

clarity

D1-D10, (D11), (D12). No overall judgement.

rob_nma

(R1-R3), D1-D3, Results, Conclusions.

probast, probast_ai

D1-D4, (A1-A3), Overall, Applicability.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rob_data <- data.frame(
  Author = c("Smith", "Jones", "Brown"),
  Year = c(2020, 2021, 2022),
  D1 = c("Low", "High", "Some concerns"),
  D2 = c("Low", "Low", "High"),
  D3 = c("Some concerns", "Low", "Low"),
  D4 = "Low",
  D5 = "Low")

rob_plot(rob_data, add_rob_legend = TRUE)
} # }
